cues: Thirty five point five grams of chlorine, twelve of magnesium, nine of aluminium.
Each balances the same one point zero zero eight grams of hydrogen.

That balancing mass is the equivalent weight: the parts by mass of a substance that combine with or displace one point zero zero eight parts of hydrogen, eight of oxygen, or thirty five point five of chlorine.
